jobs.title: SSC Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: 10+2 / Intermediate from a recognised board; DEO posts in C&AG need 12th with Science & Maths
jobs.ageNote: As on 01-08-2026 (born 02-08-1999 to 01-08-2008). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 yrs, OBC 3 yrs, PwBD 10–15 yrs
jobs.fee: ₹100; no fee for women, SC/ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen (fee payable till 8 Oct 2026)
jobs.salary: Pay Level 2 to Level 5 (₹19,900 – ₹92,300) depending on post
jobs.about: CHSL recruits Lower Division Clerks/Junior Secretariat Assistants and Data Entry Operators for central government ministries and offices. It is the main SSC exam for students who have passed Class 12. Selected candidates do office, record and data work in central departments.
steps: Go to ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR) if you have not already
Log in and open the CHSL 2026 application form under "Apply"
Fill personal, educational and exam-centre preferences carefully
Upload a live photograph and signature as instructed
Pay the fee online (if applicable) before the fee deadline
Submit and download/print the final application for your records

jobs.title: SSC Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Diploma or degree in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical engineering as per post (some posts need experience with diploma)
jobs.ageNote: Up to 30 yrs for most posts, 32 yrs for CPWD and some others; reckoned on 01-08-2026. Usual SC/ST/OBC/PwBD relaxation
jobs.examDate: Paper I: 2–6 Nov 2026; Paper II: Dec 2026 (tentative)
jobs.fee: ₹100 (General/OBC/EWS); exempt for women, SC/ST, PwBD, ex-servicemen
jobs.about: SSC JE recruits Junior Engineers for departments such as CPWD, MES, BRO and the Central Water Commission. It suits diploma or B.Tech holders in civil, mechanical or electrical engineering. JEs supervise construction, maintenance and technical works.
steps: Go to ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR) if you have not already
Log in and open the JE 2026 application form under "Apply"
Fill personal, educational and exam-centre preferences carefully
Upload a live photograph and signature as instructed
Pay the fee online (if applicable) before the fee deadline
Submit and download/print the final application for your records

jobs.title: SSC CPO – Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police & CAPFs 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university; male SI (Exe) Delhi Police applicants also need a valid LMV driving licence (as per notification)
jobs.ageNote: Relaxation: SC/ST 5 yrs, OBC 3 yrs, ex-servicemen as per rules; widows/divorced women up to 35 (UR) / 40 (SC/ST)
jobs.fee: ₹100; no fee for women, SC/ST and ex-servicemen (fee payment till 1 Oct 2026)
jobs.about: SSC CPO fills Sub-Inspector posts in Delhi Police, the CAPFs (BSF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB) and SI Fire in CISF. It is for graduates who want a uniformed officer-level career in policing. This year has 1,871 vacancies, and the correction window is 8–10 Oct 2026.
steps: Go to ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR) if you have not already
Log in and open the CPO 2026 application form under "Apply"
Fill personal, educational and exam-centre preferences carefully
Upload a live photograph and signature as instructed
Pay the fee online (if applicable) before the fee deadline
Submit and download/print the final application for your records

jobs.title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027
jobs.qualificationDetail: B.E./B.Tech (or equivalent) in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical or Electronics & Telecommunication engineering
jobs.fee: ₹200; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.salary: Group A service, Pay Level 10 (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500) at entry
jobs.about: ESE (often called IES) recruits Group A engineers for Railways, CPWD, Central Engineering services, Telecom and other technical cadres. It is meant for engineering graduates in civil, mechanical, electrical or E&T streams. Selected officers manage large government engineering projects.
steps: Register / log in with your One-Time Registration (OTR) on upsconline.nic.in
Open the Engineering Services (Preliminary) Examination 2027 application and fill Part-I details
Choose exam centres and upload photo, signature and photo-ID
Pay the fee online or by cash at SBI (if not exempt)
Submit the form before 6 PM on the last date and download the confirmation

jobs.title: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination 2027
jobs.qualificationDetail: Master's degree in Geology, Applied Geology, Geophysics, Chemistry, Hydrogeology or related subjects as per post
jobs.ageNote: As on 01-01-2027 (born 02-01-1995 to 01-01-2006). Usual SC/ST/OBC/PwBD relaxation
jobs.fee: ₹200; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.salary: Group A posts at Pay Level 10 (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500)
jobs.about: This exam recruits Geologists, Geophysicists, Chemists and Hydrogeologists for the Geological Survey of India and the Central Ground Water Board. It suits postgraduates in earth sciences or chemistry. Work includes field surveys, mineral exploration and groundwater studies.
steps: Register / log in with your One-Time Registration (OTR) on upsconline.nic.in
Open the Combined Geo-Scientist (Preliminary) Examination 2027 application and fill Part-I details
Choose exam centres and upload photo, signature and photo-ID
Pay the fee online or by cash at SBI (if not exempt)
Submit the form before 6 PM on the last date and download the confirmation

jobs.title: UPSC EPFO Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university
jobs.ageNote: Upper limit 35 yrs for UR/EWS, 38 for OBC, 40 for SC/ST; PwBD relaxation as per rules
jobs.fee: ₹25; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.about: APFCs are Group A officers in the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation under the Ministry of Labour. They handle PF administration, enforcement and settlement of claims. Any graduate within the age limit can apply under Special Advertisement No. 52/2026.
steps: Read the full advertisement on upsc.gov.in and check the post-wise eligibility
Register/log in on the ORA portal at upsconline.nic.in
Select the post under Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 and fill the online recruitment application
Upload required certificates (age, qualification, experience, category) as PDFs
Pay ₹25 fee online or by cash at SBI (exempt for SC/ST/PwBD/women)
Submit before 6 PM on the closing date and print the application

jobs.title: UPSC Direct Recruitment – Advertisement No. 09/2026 (40 posts)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Post-wise degrees: e.g. engineering for Agricultural Engineer, MBBS/BUMS for medical posts, M.Sc/PG for Scientist B, BVSc for Veterinary Assistant Surgeon
jobs.ageNote: Upper age limit differs for each post; see the advertisement
jobs.fee: ₹25; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.salary: Varies by post (7th CPC pay levels)
jobs.about: This advertisement covers 12 posts across ministries, including Agricultural Engineer, Scientist B, Civilian Medical Officer, Assistant Industrial Adviser and Veterinary Assistant Surgeon. It suits professionals with the specific degree each post demands. Selection is usually by interview, sometimes after a recruitment test.
steps: Read the full advertisement on upsc.gov.in and check the post-wise eligibility
Register/log in on the ORA portal at upsconline.nic.in
Select the post under Advertisement No. 09/2026 and fill the online recruitment application
Upload required certificates (age, qualification, experience, category) as PDFs
Pay ₹25 fee online or by cash at SBI (exempt for SC/ST/PwBD/women)
Submit before 6 PM on the closing date and print the application

jobs.fee: ₹25; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.location: All India (one post in UT Ladakh)
jobs.about: This UPSC advertisement fills 34 posts, including Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil/Electronics), Research Officer, Superintendent (Translation), Horticulture Development Officer and Soil Conservation Assistant. jobs.qualificationDetail: LLB for Assistant Public Prosecutor/Law Officer; MBBS + PG for Specialist posts; relevant degree for Assistant Editor
jobs.ageNote: Post-wise upper age limits; see the advertisement
jobs.fee: ₹25; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.salary: Varies by post (7th CPC pay levels)
jobs.location: Delhi / All India (Ladakh posts in UT Ladakh)
jobs.about: The largest UPSC selection advertisement this season, it includes 140 Assistant Public Prosecutor posts in the Delhi Prosecution Directorate and 64 Assistant Professor (Specialist Grade III) posts in Health & Family Welfare. Law and medical graduates should check post-wise eligibility. Ladakh law posts close on 9 Oct 2026.

Pay ₹25 fee online or by cash at SBI (exempt for SC/ST/PwBD/women)
Submit before 6 PM on the closing date and print the application

jobs.title: UPSC Direct Recruitment – Advertisement No. 12/2026 (13 posts)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Law degree for Assistant Legislative Counsel/Law Officer; sugar technology qualification for JTO; MBBS + DM/PG for Cardiology specialist
jobs.ageNote: Post-wise upper age limits; see the advertisement
jobs.fee: ₹25; no fee for women, SC/ST and PwBD
jobs.about: This advertisement has 8 Assistant Legislative Counsel posts in the Ministry of Law, 3 Law Officer posts in GNCT Delhi, a Junior Technical Officer (Sugar Technology) at the National Sugar Institute and a Cardiology Specialist at NDMC. It suits law graduates and specialists. Applications close at 6 PM on 16 Oct 2026.
steps: Read the full advertisement on upsc.gov.in and check the post-wise eligibility
Register/log in on the ORA portal at upsconline.nic.in
Select the post under Advertisement No. 12/2026 and fill the online recruitment application
Upload required certificates (age, qualification, experience, category) as PDFs
Pay ₹25 fee online or by cash at SBI (exempt for SC/ST/PwBD/women)
Submit before 6 PM on the closing date and print the application

jobs.title: Indian Army SSC (Tech) 68 Men & SSCW (Tech) Women – April 2027 course
jobs.qualificationDetail: B.E./B.Tech in the notified engineering stream (final-year students eligible as per notification); unmarried candidates
jobs.ageNote: Age band as per notification (reckoned on 01-04-2027)
jobs.examDate: No written exam – SSB interviews after shortlisting
jobs.about: Short Service Commission (Technical) lets engineering graduates join the Army as officers without a written test. This round has 350 seats for men and 31 for women (incl. defence widows). Training is at OTA/PCTA before commission as Lieutenant.
steps: Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in and register (or log in) as an officer candidate
Open the "SSC (Tech) 68 Men / SSCW (Tech) Women" link under Officer Entry – Apply/Login
Fill personal, educational and contact details exactly as in certificates
Upload or keep ready the required documents for SSB verification
Submit before the closing time and take two printouts of the roll-number application
Watch your email/SMS for SSB centre and date allotment

jobs.title: Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course (April 2027)
jobs.qualificationDetail: LLB (3-yr or 5-yr) with at least 55% aggregate, eligible for Bar Council registration, and appeared in CLAT PG 2026; unmarried
jobs.examDate: No written exam – CLAT PG 2026 score + SSB
jobs.about: The Judge Advocate General branch is the Army’s legal wing, handling military law, courts-martial and legal advice. Law graduates with a CLAT PG 2026 score can join as Short Service Commission officers. Shortlisting uses the CLAT PG result, followed by SSB.
steps: Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in and register (or log in) as an officer candidate
Open the "JAG Entry Scheme 125 Course" link under Officer Entry – Apply/Login
Fill personal, educational and contact details exactly as in certificates
Upload or keep ready the required documents for SSB verification
Submit before the closing time and take two printouts of the roll-number application
Watch your email/SMS for SSB centre and date allotment

jobs.title: Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 125th Course (April 2027)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Graduation with required marks and NCC 'C' certificate (wards of battle casualties exempted from 'C' certificate as per rules)
jobs.ageNote: Age band as per notification (reckoned on 01-01-2027)
jobs.examDate: No written exam – SSB interviews after shortlisting
jobs.about: This entry lets graduates holding the NCC 'C' certificate join the Army as Short Service Commission officers without a written exam. There are 70 seats for men and 6 for women, including seats for wards of battle casualties. Women's applications ran 21 Jul – 21 Aug 2026.
steps: Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in and register (or log in) as an officer candidate
Open the "NCC Special Entry Scheme 125 Course" link under Officer Entry – Apply/Login
Fill personal, educational and contact details exactly as in certificates
Upload or keep ready the required documents for SSB verification
Submit before the closing time and take two printouts of the roll-number application
Watch your email/SMS for SSB centre and date allotment

jobs.title: Indian Army Technical Graduate Course (TGC-145) – July 2027
jobs.qualificationDetail: B.E./B.Tech in the notified engineering stream (final-year students can apply as per notification); unmarried male candidates
jobs.ageNote: Age band as per notification (reckoned on 01-07-2027)
jobs.examDate: No written exam – SSB interviews after shortlisting
jobs.about: TGC gives engineering graduates a Permanent Commission in the Army after training at the Indian Military Academy, Dehradun. TGC-145 has 30 seats and the course starts in July 2027. Applications open on 30 Sep 2026 at 3 PM and close on 29 Oct 2026 at 3 PM.
steps: Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in and register (or log in) as an officer candidate
Open the "TGC-145" link under Officer Entry – Apply/Login
Fill personal, educational and contact details exactly as in certificates
Upload or keep ready the required documents for SSB verification
Submit before the closing time and take two printouts of the roll-number application
Watch your email/SMS for SSB centre and date allotment

jobs.title: Army Dental Corps – Short Service Commission Dental Officers 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: BDS/MDS with one-year compulsory rotatory internship completed by 30-06-2026, valid DCI registration, and appeared in NEET (MDS) 2026
jobs.ageNote: Age limit as per notification
jobs.examDate: Shortlisting on NEET (MDS) 2026 score; interview dates to be notified
jobs.salary: Commissioned officer pay as per Army rules (Short Service Commission)
jobs.about: The Army Dental Corps recruits dental surgeons as Short Service Commission officers to treat soldiers and their families. Dental graduates who took NEET (MDS) 2026 can apply. Selection uses the NEET MDS score followed by an interview and medical test.
steps: Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in and open the Army Dental Corps link
Register with your email and mobile number
Fill academic details and NEET (MDS) 2026 roll number/score
Upload documents as instructed
Submit before 22 Oct 2026 and print the application
Wait for interview call letter by email

jobs.title: IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant (Intake 01/2027)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Matriculation from a recognised board as per notification; unmarried male candidates only (hospitality & housekeeping roles)
jobs.ageNote: Age band as per Agnipath scheme notification
jobs.salary: Agniveer package (₹30,000/month in year 1, rising yearly) + Seva Nidhi
jobs.about: Under the Agnipath scheme the IAF hires Agniveervayu in non-combatant roles such as hospitality and housekeeping for a four-year term. This intake is open to unmarried men and uses offline applications sent to Air Force stations. It suits 10th-pass youngsters who want to serve in the Air Force.
steps: Download the notification and application format from the official IAF Agnipath website
Check eligibility and pick the Air Force station/selection venue
Fill the application form by hand and attach self-attested documents
Paste a recent photograph and sign the form
Send/submit the form to the specified Air Force station before 17 Aug 2026

jobs.title: Indian Coast Guard Civilian Group C Posts (Store Keeper, Engine Driver, Lascar, MTS etc.) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: 10th or 12th pass as per post; trade certificate / driving licence / experience for Engine Driver, Lascar and Civilian Motor Transport Driver
jobs.ageNote: As on 01-09-2026; relaxation as per Government of India rules
jobs.salary: As per 7th CPC pay level of each post
jobs.location: As per Coast Guard unit in notification
jobs.about: The Coast Guard periodically recruits civilian staff such as Store Keeper, Engine Driver, Lascar, Civilian Motor Transport Driver and MTS for its regional units. This small batch has 6 posts and is applied for offline by post. It suits 10th/12th-pass candidates with the trade skills each post needs.
steps: Get the official notification and application format from the Indian Coast Guard website
Fill the form in the prescribed format
Attach self-attested copies of certificates and photographs
Write the post name on the envelope
Send by post to the address in the notification before 3 Nov 2026
documents: Trade/ITI certificate or driving licence (as per post)

jobs.title: CRPF Head Constable (GD) & Constable (GD) – Sports Quota 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Constable (GD): 10th pass; Head Constable (GD): 12th pass; plus the required sports achievements in notified disciplines
jobs.ageNote: Age limits as per Advertisement No. R.II-21/2026-Sports
jobs.fee: ₹100; no fee for SC/ST and women
jobs.about: CRPF hires meritorious sportspersons directly as Head Constables and Constables (GD) across 21+ sports. There are 182 HC and 339 Constable vacancies for men and women. Online applications run from 12 Oct to 11 Nov 2026.
steps: Open rect.crpf.gov.in and read the sports-quota advertisement
Register with mobile number and email
Fill personal, education and sports achievement details
Upload photo, signature and sports certificates
Pay ₹100 fee online (if applicable)
Submit and print the application/admit card when issued

jobs.title: ITBP Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: 10th pass with ITI/certificate in Motor Mechanic or equivalent experience as per notification; male candidates
jobs.ageNote: Age limits as per notification
jobs.about: ITBP needs Head Constables to maintain and repair its vehicle fleet in border areas. The 21 posts are open to male candidates with a motor-mechanic trade qualification. Selected candidates join a uniformed CAPF career.
steps: Visit recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in and register
Choose Head Constable (Motor Mechanic)
Fill the form and upload photo, signature and certificates
Pay ₹100 fee online if applicable
Submit before 11:59 PM on 27 Oct 2026 and save the printout

jobs.title: ITBP Head Constable (Education & Stress Counsellor) 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Graduation as specified in the notification (education/psychology related subjects as per rules); men and women
jobs.ageNote: Age limits as per notification
jobs.about: These Head Constables support the education and mental wellbeing of ITBP personnel posted in tough border areas. There are 16 posts open to both men and women. It suits graduates interested in counselling inside a uniformed force.
steps: Visit recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in and register
Choose Head Constable (Education & Stress Counsellor)
Fill the form and upload photo, signature and certificates
Pay ₹100 fee online if applicable
Submit before 11:59 PM on 27 Oct 2026 and save the printout

jobs.title: ITBP (CAPF) Medical Officers – Super Specialist, Specialist & GDMO 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: MBBS with valid registration for Medical Officer; PG for Specialist; super-specialty (DM/MCh) for Super Specialist
jobs.ageNote: Post-wise age limits as per notification
jobs.about: ITBP recruits Group A doctors for all Central Armed Police Forces through this drive. It has 5 Super Specialist, 162 Specialist and 115 Medical Officer posts. Doctors get gazetted officer rank and serve force hospitals across India.
steps: Visit recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in and register
Choose the medical officer post you are eligible for
Fill academic, registration and experience details
Upload photo, signature and degree/registration certificates
Submit before 8 Sep 2026 and print the application

jobs.title: Assam Rifles Technical & Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: Minimum 10th pass; ITI/diploma/trade certificate or 12th as required for each of the 18 trades; male candidates
jobs.ageNote: General limit 18–25 yrs (varies by trade); relaxation as per rules
jobs.about: Assam Rifles is recruiting 354 Group C technical and tradesman personnel such as Warrant Officer (Cipher/Draughtsman) and Riflemen in electrical, mechanical and building trades. It is open to eligible male Indian citizens. The notification is dated 27 Aug 2026 and online applications run 28 Sep – 28 Oct 2026.
steps: Visit assamrifles.gov.in and open the recruitment rally link
Register and choose your trade
Fill details and upload photo, signature and certificates
Pay the fee online if applicable
Submit before 28 Oct 2026 and download the admit card for the rally later

jobs.title: MP Police Constable (GD) Recruitment 2026
jobs.qualificationDetail: As per MPESB rule book for Police Constable 2026 (High School / 10th pass under previous rules; check notification)
jobs.ageNote: Age limits and MP domicile relaxations as per MPESB rule book
jobs.salary: As per MP Government pay rules for Constable
jobs.about: MPESB is filling 7,500 Constable (GD) posts in Madhya Pradesh Police: 6,800 non-SAF posts for men and women and 700 SAF posts for men. It suits young candidates who want a state police career in MP. Online applications run 22 Sep – 6 Oct 2026.
steps: Read the rule book on esb.mp.gov.in
Complete MP Online profile registration / KYC
Fill the Police Constable 2026 form and choose exam cities
Upload photo and signature
Pay the fee online
Submit and print the confirmation

jobs.title: Telangana State Police Constable Recruitment 2026
jobs.org: Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TGPRB)
jobs.qualificationDetail: Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent as per TGPRB notification
jobs.ageNote: Age limits and relaxations as per TGPRB notification
jobs.salary: As per Telangana Government pay scales
jobs.about: TGPRB (earlier TSLPRB) is recruiting about 7,139 constable-level posts across civil, AR, TSSP and other wings of Telangana Police. It suits 12th-pass candidates who want a state police job in Telangana. The deadline was extended to 16 Sep 2026 (5 PM).
selection: Physical Measurement Test & Physical Efficiency Test
steps: Visit the official TGPRB website and read the notification
Register with mobile number and email
Fill the online application and choose posts
Upload photo, signature and certificates
Pay the fee online
Submit and download the application PDF
